mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, c.category_name AS type, a.start_time, a.location, a.max_count, a.signed_count, a.duration, a.status, a.category_id, a.org_id, o.org_name, a.deadline, a.contact, a.description
FROM volunteer_activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN org_info o ON o.id = a.org_id
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId}) AS activity_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS ongoing_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup s JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND s.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_signup_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup s JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND s.status IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED')) AS approved_signup_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup s JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND s.status = 'REJECTED') AS rejected_signup_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record r JOIN activity_signup s ON s.id = r.signup_id JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId}) AS attendance_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record r JOIN activity_signup s ON s.id = r.signup_id JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND r.status IN ('SIGNED_IN', 'SIGNED_OUT', 'ABNORMAL')) AS signed_attendance_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record r JOIN activity_signup s ON s.id = r.signup_id JOIN volunteer_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND r.status IN ('NOT_SIGNED', 'ABSENT')) AS unsigned_total
